title: Dynamic Shape Control of Soft Trunk Robots
summary: Controlling the shape profile of soft trunk robots extends their reach into complex regions of the workspace and enhances their use in practical applications. Recent advances in soft robot design have enabled soft trunk robots to achieve greater flexibility in conforming to complex shapes. Specifically, trunk robots whose geometries are designed as helicoids have been shown to enable extreme shape-changing capabilities. Their compliance makes them highly nonlinear, which in turn makes shape control difficult. On similar tendon-driven trunk robots, model-based controllers based on the theory of adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs) have achieved high accuracy in closed-loop end-effector tracking. We extend this approach by learning an aSSM model of the full body of a trimmed-helicoid soft trunk robot from data and use this in a model predictive control (MPC) scheme to demonstrate a range of shape control tasks on hardware. On closed-loop dynamic shape regulation, our method outperforms the available linear baselines by a factor of 10. In human-in-the-loop interactive demos, our method completes section-by-section shaping and balances a tennis ball for over 25 seconds, while the linear baselines fall short. A model-free reinforcement learning policy trained for 12 hours on hardware fails on the same balancing task. These results establish aSSM-based MPC as a practical route to full-body shape control on real soft hardware.
tldr: Presents an MPC framework using data-learned adiabatic spectral submanifold (aSSM) models for full-body dynamic shape control of a trimmed-helicoid soft trunk robot, outperforming linear baselines and a model-free RL policy on shape regulation and ball-balancing tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出利用数据学习的绝热谱子流形（aSSM）模型进行模型预测控制（MPC），实现对修剪螺旋软体躯干机器人的全身动态形状控制，在形状调节和平衡球任务上优于线性基线和强化学习策略。
summary_zh: 摘要：控制软体躯干机器人的形状轮廓可扩展其工作空间内复杂区域的覆盖能力，并增强其在实际应用中的效用。近年来软体机器人设计方面的进展使得软体躯干机器人能够以更高的灵活性适应复杂形状。特别地，几何形状设计为螺旋面的躯干机器人已被证明具备极强的形状变化能力。其柔顺性导致系统高度非线性，进而使得形状控制变得困难。在类似的腱驱动躯干机器人上，基于绝热谱子流形（aSSMs）理论的模型控制方法已在闭环末端执行器跟踪中实现高精度。我们将该方法扩展至从数据中学习修剪螺旋面软体躯干机器人整体的aSSM模型，并将其用于模型预测控制（MPC）方案中，以在硬件上展示一系列形状控制任务。在闭环动态形状调节中，我们的方法比现有线性基线方法性能提升一个数量级（10倍）。在人在回路交互演示中，我们的方法完成了逐段成形，并平衡网球超过25秒，而线性基线方法无法完成该任务。在硬件上训练了12小时的无模型强化学习策略在相同平衡任务上失败。这些结果确立了基于aSSM的MPC作为在真实软体硬件上实现全身形状控制的实用途径。

title: When can multi-fragment 2D/3D registration be trusted? Calibrated certification and uncertainty-driven view planning for pelvic fracture fluoroscopy
summary: Registering a segmented CT to fluoroscopy can locate every fracture fragment but can guide surgery only when trusted. After each shot, our closed loop registers all fragments, bounds their errors with a calibrated sandwich covariance, flags implausible or ambiguous ones, and stops or plans the next view. On simulated fluoroscopy of 60 held-out fracture CTs with realistic image uncertainty, 95% bounds covered 83% of unflagged fragments and 91% of those within 5mm, but from the second view on 14% failed by over 5mm, a third with bounds of at most 2mm. A fragment's shift when a view was added separated tightly bounded failures best (exploratory; AUC 0.94, bound 0.81). Requiring that the newest view moved no fragment beyond its bound, preferred post hoc, lowered false stops at 2mm from 23% to 6% overall, with 345 instead of 362 correct ones but more trajectories uncertified; delaying the stop did not, and other signals at equal acceptance left 10-15% false. With a segmentation error shared by all views (median Dice 0.89), 21% of this rule's stops were false against 10% without it (15 cases; exploratory). Minimax planning certified sooner than the clinical protocol without the check (4.20 versus 4.72 shots, Holm p <0.001), but no criterion reached the pre-specified endpoint, a true 2mm error, significantly sooner, even in the true basin. On real fluoroscopy of five intact pelves no 2mm certificate was false. Trust takes evidence across views, not only a calibrated local bound.
tldr: This paper presents a calibrated certification framework for multi-fragment 2D/3D registration in pelvic fracture fluoroscopy, combining covariance-based error bounds, ambiguity/improbability flagging, and uncertainty-driven next-view planning to decide when a registration can be trusted. Validation shows the approach can reduce false stops and plan views sooner than clinical protocols, though true 2mm-error certification remains difficult, especially under segmentation errors.
tldr_zh: 本文针对骨盆骨折荧光透视中的多碎片2D/3D配准，提出了一种带校准的认证框架，利用协方差误差界、不可信/模糊标记以及不确定性驱动的下一视角规划，判断配准何时可被信任。实验表明该方法可减少错误停止并比临床方案更早规划视角，但在真实2mm误差认证上仍具挑战，尤其在分割误差存在时。
summary_zh:
摘要：

将分割后的CT与荧光透视配准可以定位每个骨折碎片，但只有在可信时才能指导手术。每次曝光后，我们的闭环系统对所有碎片进行配准，用校准的夹心协方差界定其误差，标记不合理或模糊的碎片，并决定停止或规划下一次视图。在含有现实图像不确定性的60例留出骨折CT模拟荧光透视中，95%的边界覆盖了83%的未标记碎片，以及91%误差在5mm以内的碎片；但从第二视图起，14%的碎片误差超过5mm，其中三分之一碎片的边界不超过2mm。增加视图时碎片的位移是区分紧边界失败的最佳信号（探索性；AUC 0.94，边界0.81）。要求最新视图不使任何碎片移动超出其边界（事后偏好）将2mm处的假停止率从23%降至6%，正确停止从362次变为345次，但更多轨迹未获认证；延迟停止没有效果，其他信号在接受率相同时仍有10–15%的假性。当存在所有视图共享的分割误差（中位Dice 0.89）时，该规则的停止中有21%为假，而无此误差时为10%（15例；探索性）。最小最大规划比无检查的临床方案更早实现认证（4.20对4.72次曝光，Holm p<0.001），但没有任何标准能显著更早达到预设终点——真实2mm误差，即使在真实吸引域内也是如此。在五例完整骨盆的真实荧光透视中，没有2mm认证是假的。信任需要跨视图的证据，而不仅仅是校准的局部边界。

title: $\mathcal{C}^\infty$ Smooth Trajectory Planning with Application to Soft Robots
summary: High motion performance and avoiding structural vibrations rely on smooth trajectory planning. The smoothness requirement depends on the robot's complexity in terms of the number of degrees of freedom and system order due to the flexibility of the joints and links. For industrial robots, the smoothness requirements have been determined and subsequently taken into account. Although unknown for soft continuum robots, the exact smoothness requirement can potentially be much larger than previously considered ones such as $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^4}$ for collaborative robots and $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^5}$ for quadcopter drones. To address this gap, we introduce a $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^\infty}$-smooth trajectory generator that respects defined kinematic limits and generates infinitely differentiable trajectories. The generated path addresses and generalizes to all smoothness requirements, where a transition between sequential states is needed. Therefore, all trajectories have continuous velocity, acceleration, jerk, snap, crackle, pop, etc. Of particular interest is the case of null boundary conditions, i.e., all derivatives at the start and end of the trajectory are equal to zero. We verified and evaluated our proposed approach in simulations and on hardware.
tldr: The paper proposes a C^∞-smooth trajectory generator for soft continuum robots that respects kinematic limits and produces infinitely differentiable trajectories, addressing potentially higher smoothness requirements than prior C^4/C^5 planners. The method is validated in simulation and on hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向软体连续机器人的C^∞光滑轨迹生成器，在满足运动学限制的同时生成无限可微的轨迹，以应对可能高于以往C^4/C^5规划的平滑度需求，并在仿真和硬件上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 高性能运动与避免结构振动依赖于平滑的轨迹规划。平滑性要求取决于机器人的复杂性，包括自由度数以及因关节和连杆柔性引起的系统阶次。对于工业机器人，平滑性要求已被确定并予以考虑。尽管软体连续体机器人的平滑性要求尚不明确，但确切的平滑性要求可能远高于先前所考虑的水平，例如协作机器人的$\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^4}$和四旋翼无人机的$\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^5}$。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种$\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^\infty}$-平滑轨迹生成器，该生成器在满足既定运动学限制的同时，生成无限可微的轨迹。所生成的轨迹能够满足并推广至所有需要在连续状态之间进行过渡的平滑性要求。因此，所有轨迹均具有连续的速度、加速度、加加速度、跃度、爆裂度、弹跳度等。特别值得关注的是零边界条件的情况，即轨迹起点和终点的所有导数均为零。我们在仿真和硬件上验证并评估了所提出的方法。

title: VirtualTrialHarness: Coordinating Agentic Operationalization of Virtual Trial Protocols Across Complex Clinical Schemas
summary: Virtual trials use routinely collected clinical data to evaluate treatment strategies, but translating a study protocol into an executable analysis requires determining how clinical concepts and study requirements should be represented in the available data and applied consistently across the workflow. These decisions depend on local data representations and operational conventions and can involve source selection, patient and encounter identity, linkage, and temporal interpretation. Here we introduce VirtualTrialHarness (VTHarness), an agent framework that coordinates virtual-trial operationalization by selecting reusable procedural skills for each workflow stage and uses explicit contracts to maintain consistent study decisions across stages. We also introduce VTBenchmark for evaluating source selection and cohort construction. Across three complex synthetic environments, VTHarness successfully produced all required cohort outputs matching the references in 95.1% of workflows after requirement clarification, compared with 60.4% using retrieval from the same procedural corpus. Procedural skills improved source recovery across three language models and increased source overlap with analyst code in 13 Mayo Clinic cases. Site-specific adaptation enabled reference-matched cohort execution across eight MIMIC-IV tasks. Within the Mayo Clinic Virtual Trials Program, the framework supported investigator review of cohort construction and endpoint analysis. These findings support coordinating procedural guidance with workflow decisions to improve virtual-trial implementation across complex clinical schemas.
tldr: VTHarness is an agent framework that operationalizes virtual-trial protocols by selecting reusable procedural skills and using explicit contracts across workflow stages, with a benchmark (VTBenchmark) and results showing improved cohort construction across synthetic, MIMIC-IV, and Mayo Clinic settings.
tldr_zh: VTHarness是一个协调虚拟试验流程的智能体框架，通过可复用程序技能和显式契约将试验方案转化为可执行分析，在合成环境、MIMIC-IV和Mayo Clinic中展示了优于检索基线的队列构建效果。
summary_zh: 摘要：虚拟试验利用常规采集的临床数据来评估治疗策略，但将研究方案转化为可执行的分析，需要确定如何在可用数据中表示临床概念和研究要求，并在整个工作流程中一致地应用。这些决策依赖于本地数据表示和操作惯例，可能涉及源选择、患者和就诊身份识别、链接以及时间解释。本文介绍了VirtualTrialHarness（VTHarness），一个智能体框架，通过为每个工作流阶段选择可复用的流程技能来协调虚拟试验的操作化，并使用显式契约在各阶段之间保持一致的研究决策。我们还推出了VTBenchmark，用于评估源选择和队列构建。在三个复杂的合成环境中，经过需求澄清后，VTHarness在95.1%的工作流中成功生成了与参考匹配的所有必需队列输出，而使用同一流程语料库进行检索的匹配率为60.4%。流程技能提高了三种语言模型下的源恢复率，并在13个梅奥诊所病例中增加了与分析师代码的源重叠。站点特定适配使得在八个MIMIC-IV任务中能够执行与参考匹配的队列。在梅奥诊所虚拟试验项目中，该框架支持研究者对队列构建和终点分析进行审查。这些发现支持将流程指导与工作流决策相协调，以改善复杂临床模式下的虚拟试验实施。

title: Weight-space programming for auditing clinical decision networks
summary: Machine learning models in radiotherapy are commissioned by testing them on cases with known answers, which may not reveal a shortcut that the test cases share with the training data. Frontier language models have recently been reported to read and write the raw weights of small neural networks, an ability called weight-space programming. The purpose of this study was to determine whether such a model, given only a clinical protocol and a network's weights, can audit and repair the network. Networks with 433 to 4,801 parameters were trained to screen head-and-neck planning requests against four rules. Flaws were planted through the training data: confounds that hid each rule, a 3 Gy shift in the cord threshold, and a hidden trigger. Claude Opus 5.5 audited each network blind, without tools, data or code execution, and every claim and repair was tested on about 420,000 requests. The language model named the broken rule in 16 of 18 flawed networks (95% CI 67% to 97%), including all 15 with a confound or a threshold shift. It repaired each of the 16 by changing a median of 3 parameters. Fine-tuning on protocol-labeled requests also repaired every network, but changed nearly every parameter. Each confound and shift it found was visible in single units, and a simple statistic chosen for each flaw type found the same flaws. It cleared 2 of 5 healthy networks without being forced and found 1 of 3 triggers. Testing against the protocol detected every flaw, and black-box testing found the confounds and the shift faster. The results indicate that, in small networks, weight-space programming can locate and repair flaws that silence an input or shift a threshold, but cannot yet certify that a network is correct.
tldr: This paper tests whether a frontier language model (Claude Opus 5.5) can audit and repair small radiotherapy screening networks by reading raw weights, given only the clinical protocol. It found the model can identify and fix confound- and threshold-shift flaws by changing a few parameters, but cannot certify correctness or reliably find hidden triggers.
tldr_zh: 本文测试前沿语言模型（Claude Opus 5.5）在仅凭临床协议和网络权重的情况下，能否通过读取原始权重视察并修复小型放疗筛查网络。结果表明，模型能发现并修复混杂因素和阈值偏移类缺陷（仅改动少量参数），但无法保证网络完全正确，且对隐藏触发器的检出率有限。
summary_zh: 机器学习模型在放射治疗中的应用通常是通过使用已知答案的病例进行测试来完成的，但这种测试可能无法揭示测试病例与训练数据共享的捷径。前沿语言模型近期已被报道能够读取和写入小型神经网络的原始权重，这种能力被称为权重空间编程。本研究旨在确定，仅凭临床方案和网络权重，此类模型能否审计并修复网络。训练了参数数量从433到4801不等的网络，用于根据四条规则筛查头颈部计划申请。通过训练数据植入了缺陷：隐藏每条规则的混杂因素、脊髓阈值偏移3 Gy，以及一个隐藏触发器。Claude Opus 5.5对每个网络进行了盲审，不使用工具、数据或代码执行，所有声明和修复均在约420,000个申请上进行了测试。该语言模型在18个有缺陷的网络中正确指出了16个的违规规则（95%置信区间67%至97%），包括所有15个存在混杂因素或阈值偏移的网络。它通过更改中位数为3个参数修复了这16个网络。基于协议标记申请进行微调也能修复每个网络，但几乎改变了每个参数。它发现的每个混杂因素和偏移均可在单个单元中可见，并且为每种缺陷类型选择的简单统计量也发现了相同的缺陷。它未被强制就清除了5个健康网络中的2个，并发现了3个触发器中的1个。对照协议进行测试检测到了每个缺陷，黑盒测试更快地发现了混杂因素和偏移。结果表明，在小型网络中，权重空间编程可以定位并修复使输入静默或阈值偏移的缺陷，但尚不能证明网络是完全正确的。

title: Riemannian Optimization-based Whole-body Obstacle Avoidance for Mobile Continuum Robots in Cluttered Environments
summary: Inspired by the coordination of global motion and local shape adaptation in snakes, elephant trunks, and octopus arms, we propose a unified planning and control framework for mobile continuum robots in cluttered and confined environments. Existing approaches often address high-level path planning and local motion control separately, limiting coordinated base-arm motion, kinematic consistency, and collision avoidance. Our framework integrates long-horizon trajectory planning with real-time geometric refinement under kinematic and environmental constraints. The global layer combines A* search with minimum-jerk planning to generate smooth reference trajectories. The local layer uses a geometry-consistent inverse kinematics solver and Riemannian optimization to coordinate mobile-base motion and continuum deformation while avoiding obstacles. We evaluate the framework through simulated pipe-traversal tasks with multiple baseline planners and real-world experiments involving navigation among dense obstacles and manipulation in confined spaces. Results demonstrate improved motion consistency, feasibility, and adaptability, supporting coordinated whole-body motion of mobile continuum robots in constrained environments.
tldr: The paper presents a unified planning-and-control framework for mobile continuum robots, combining A* with minimum-jerk global trajectory planning and a local Riemannian-optimization-based IK/obstacle-avoidance layer to coordinate base motion and continuum deformation in cluttered environments, with simulated and real-world validation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种面向移动连续体机器人的统一规划与控制框架，将A*与最小加加速度全局规划同基于黎曼优化的局部几何一致逆运动学/避障相结合，实现基座与连续体变形的协调，并在仿真和真实环境中验证。
summary_zh: 受蛇、象鼻和章鱼臂中全局运动与局部形状协调的启发，我们提出了一种面向杂散和受限环境中移动连续体机器人的统一规划与控制框架。现有方法通常将高层路径规划与局部运动控制分开处理，限制了基座-手臂协同运动、运动学一致性以及避障能力。我们的框架在运动学和环境约束下，将长时域轨迹规划与实时几何细化相结合。全局层结合A*搜索与最小加加速度规划生成平滑参考轨迹；局部层采用几何一致性逆运动学求解器和黎曼优化，协调移动基座运动与连续体变形，同时实现避障。我们通过多个基线规划器进行模拟管道穿越任务，并在密集障碍物间导航和受限空间操作的真实世界实验中评估该框架。结果表明，该方法在运动一致性、可行性和适应性方面均有提升，支持移动连续体机器人在受限环境中的协调全身运动。
